The script loads the sharded input, casts exactly the 112 layer projection matrices (matched by a fully-anchored regex on the seven per-layer names) to bfloat16, leaves `embed_tokens`/`lm_head` and all other tensors as float32 with unchanged values, deletes nothing, preserves names, enforces all four required checks with assertions before writing, and packs greedily into ≤256 MiB shards where each oversized tensor lands alone (the flush-before-append logic guarantees this) with a `weight_map` index at `out/T3/model.safetensors.index.json`. The `buffer_re` pattern is dead code — `(?!)` never matches — so it correctly deletes nothing, consistent with clause 3.
